msg.XRP_MOTOR_EFFORT_TOOLTIP: Sets the selected motor's effort from -1 for full reverse to 1 for full forward.
msg.XRP_MOTOR_SPEED_TOOLTIP: Sets the selected motor's target speed in revolutions per minute; zero disables speed control and stops the motor.
msg.XRP_MOTOR_DIRECTION_TOOLTIP: Sets which direction is forward for the selected motor.
msg.XRP_MOTOR_GET_SPEED_TOOLTIP: Returns the selected motor's current speed in revolutions per minute.
msg.XRP_MOTOR_GET_POSITION_TOOLTIP: Returns the selected motor's position in revolutions since its encoder was last reset.
msg.XRP_MOTOR_GET_COUNT_TOOLTIP: Returns the selected motor's signed encoder count since its encoder was last reset.
msg.XRP_MOTOR_RESET_POSITION_TOOLTIP: Resets the selected motor's encoder position and count to zero.
msg.XRP_STRAIGHT_TOOLTIP: Drives straight for the specified distance in centimeters using the selected maximum effort; a negative distance drives backward.
msg.XRP_TURN_TOOLTIP: Turns the robot through the specified number of degrees using the selected maximum effort.
msg.XRP_SET_EFFORT_TOOLTIP: Sets the left and right drivetrain motor efforts independently from -1 for full reverse to 1 for full forward.
msg.XRP_SET_SPEED_TOOLTIP: Sets the left and right drivetrain speeds independently in centimeters per second.
msg.XRP_ARCADE_TOOLTIP: Drives using straight and turn efforts, where each input ranges from -1 to 1.
msg.XRP_STOP_MOTORS_TOOLTIP: Stops both drivetrain motors by setting their speed and effort to zero.
msg.XRP_RESET_ENCODERS_TOOLTIP: Resets both drivetrain encoder positions to zero.
msg.XRP_LEFT_ENCODER_TOOLTIP: Returns the left drivetrain encoder position in centimeters since the last reset.
msg.XRP_RIGHT_ENCODER_TOOLTIP: Returns the right drivetrain encoder position in centimeters since the last reset.
msg.XRP_SERVO_DEG_TOOLTIP: Sets the selected servo's angle in degrees from 0 through 200.
msg.XRP_SONAR_DISTANCE_TOOLTIP: Returns the sonar distance in centimeters, or 65535 when no echo is received before the timeout.
msg.XRP_LEFT_REFLECTANCE_TOOLTIP: Returns the left sensor's reflectance from 0 for white to 1 for black.
msg.XRP_RIGHT_REFLECTANCE_TOOLTIP: Returns the right sensor's reflectance from 0 for white to 1 for black.
msg.XRP_MIDDLE_REFLECTANCE_TOOLTIP: Returns the middle sensor's reflectance from 0 for white to 1 for black; this sensor is available only on supported boards.
msg.XRP_YAW_HELP: Returns the robot's unbounded yaw angle in degrees relative to its calibrated center.
msg.XRP_ROLL_TOOLTIP: Returns the robot's unbounded roll angle in degrees relative to its calibrated center.
msg.XRP_PITCH_HELP: Returns the robot's unbounded pitch angle in degrees relative to its calibrated center.
msg.XRP_ACC_X_HELP: Returns the current X-axis acceleration in milli-g units.
msg.XRP_ACC_Y_HELP: Returns the current Y-axis acceleration in milli-g units.
msg.XRP_ACC_Z_HELP: Returns the current Z-axis acceleration in milli-g units.
msg.XRP_LED_ON_TOOLTIP: Turns on the board's LED and stops any active LED blinking.
msg.XRP_LED_OFF_TOOLTIP: Turns off the board's LED and stops any active LED blinking.
msg.XRP_USER_BUTTON_TOOLTIP: Returns true while the board's user button is pressed and false otherwise.
msg.XRP_WAIT_FOR_BUTTON_TOOLTIP: Pauses the program until the board's user button is pressed and then released.
msg.XRP_WEB_FORWARD_TOOLTIP: Runs the enclosed statements when the web page's forward button is pressed.
msg.XRP_WEB_BACK_TOOLTIP: Runs the enclosed statements when the web page's back button is pressed.
msg.XRP_WEB_LEFT_TOOLTIP: Runs the enclosed statements when the web page's left button is pressed.
msg.XRP_WEB_RIGHT_TOOLTIP: Runs the enclosed statements when the web page's right button is pressed.
msg.XRP_WEB_STOP_TOOLTIP: Runs the enclosed statements when the web page's stop button is pressed.
msg.XRP_WEB_ADD_TOOLTIP: Adds a named button to the web page that runs the enclosed statements when pressed.
msg.XRP_WEB_LOG_TOOLTIP: Displays the supplied data under the given label on the XRP web page.
msg.XRP_START_WEB_SERVER_TOOLTIP: Creates a Wi-Fi access point with the supplied name and password, then starts the XRP web server.
msg.XRP_CONNECT_WEB_SERVER_TOOLTIP: Connects the XRP to an existing Wi-Fi network with the supplied name and password, then starts its web server.
msg.XRP_GP_GET_VALUE_TOOLTIP: Returns the selected gamepad joystick axis value from -1 to 1, or 0 when no value is available.
msg.XRP_GP_BUTTON_TOOLTIP: Returns true while the selected gamepad button is pressed and false otherwise.
msg.XRP_SLEEP_TOOLTIP: Pauses the program for the specified number of seconds.
msg.XRP_DASHBOARD_START_ALL_TOOLTIP: Starts sending all default XRP sensor values to the dashboard.
msg.XRP_DASHBOARD_STOP_ALL_TOOLTIP: Stops sending the default XRP sensor values to the dashboard.
msg.XRP_DASHBOARD_SET_VALUE_TOOLTIP: Creates or updates a named numeric value and sends it to the dashboard.
msg.XRP_DASHBOARD_GET_VALUE_TOOLTIP: Returns the current numeric value received for the named dashboard variable.
msg.XRP_COMMENT_TOOLTIP: Add a comment to your code.
msg.XRP_KIDS_MOVE_FORWARD_TOOLTIP: Drive forward the specified number of inches using the wheel encoders.
msg.XRP_KIDS_MOVE_BACKWARD_TOOLTIP: Drive backward the specified number of inches using the wheel encoders.
msg.XRP_KIDS_TURN_LEFT_TOOLTIP: Turn left the specified number of degrees using the robot's gyro.
msg.XRP_KIDS_TURN_RIGHT_TOOLTIP: Turn right the specified number of degrees using the robot's gyro.
